subject: ADR-196: a diff is evidence -- the fifth blind trial, 1,214,815 bytes of report down to 332,828 for more reads at level scores, and the grader that could not read its own diff
body: THE FIFTH BLIND TRIAL, run to measure ADR-195, and the defect it found in this kit's own instrument. Four fresh operators, the same four science pages, the same goals, the same grader. THE MEASUREMENT: 75 read-report calls against the fourth trial's 71 and 332,828 BYTES AGAINST 1,214,815 -- more reads for a quarter of the bytes, only 8 of the 75 the whole report where all 71 of the fourth's were. Outcomes and claims LEVEL: 80/112 and 208/260 against 82 and 213, in 408 calls against 398. ADR-195 did not make operators reach further, it made them pay a quarter as much to reach the same place; both DESTRUCTIVE goals reached a destructive act, which is ADR-194's two lower bounds now measured. THE FINDING WAS IN HERE: graded as the fourth was, the fifth scores 63 and 172 -- nineteen outcomes worse with nobody operating worse -- because grade_outcomes holds a claim against WHAT A CALL ANSWERED WITH and a `since` answer is a diff; the fall is proportional page by page to how much each used the feature, and the collection sheet, which barely did, did not move at all. apply_diff now lives beside diff_of and returns APPROXIMATE (the target's own words, fewer of them) and UNRESTORED (no value carried at all) as different things; fold_diffs deletes the unrestored and keeps the approximate, so a truncated box can cost a claim and cannot manufacture one. Diffs from before the `trimmed` register are still readable because the shortening's shapes are exact. TWO DEFECTS IN ADR-195 ITSELF, both from operators: a box could report a change it could not SHOW (two identical trimmed sides; both sides are now windowed on the first character they differ about), and a key may contain the path separator (`pollen / seed parents`), found by comparing a rebuilt document against the whole report the operator read a moment later. NOT A THUMB ON THE SCALE: the fourth trial re-graded through the folding grader is unchanged, and fold=False is kept so the cost of not folding stays a number. Nothing was re-run. verify_contract 148 -> 161, verify_tasks 329 -> 358, mutate_contract 65 -> 74, mutate_tasks 73 -> 80, blind traces 16 -> 20.
